judged_text: The update action ignores params entirely and re-renders the serialized embedding while returning 200, persisting nothing, and its client twin saveChanges in admin-embedding.js.es6 is never rendered by embedding.hbs. PUT /admin/customize/embedding is a silent no-op on a live admin surface: any caller — or a future template wiring the already-written saveChanges action — believes changes were saved when nothing was written; the action pair should be deleted or implemented.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the serialized `@embedding` without reading params or persisting anything (it’s an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`). Routes include `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`, and the Ember controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` never wires a save button/action. So this is real diff-grounded dead/incomplete surface/API that could mislead future callers, but as shipped in this diff it’s not clearly causing broken behavior because host CRUD is handled via `resources :embeddable_hosts` and the UI only adds/deletes/saves hosts there.
